items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: it took nine of me to make one Michael Brecker and not even then was I successful.

ctx.x: You know when you said “overdub” I can’t believe that — I’m going back to it, the “Widow’s Walk,” people have to listen to this because one thing that I remember, especially the first time I heard it was you were playing the melody on the tenor and then the soprano entered. Am I correct? I’m assuming that was you as well. It sounded like then there was an intertwining of two horns and then it ended up in unison.

Yeah it is me. I’m trying to think — yeah the second voice is soprano I’m pretty sure. I don’t think I did it with two tenors. But yeah on that first record there’s another one I did, I did the melody just with three horns. And it’s kind of — I’ve had fun doing that over the years. So “Sacred Hearts,” it didn’t start out originally with it being this kind of tribute album but then it did as the material kind of fell into place. So each song is kind of dedicated to somebody that I lost. Because between the…
I’ll check it out. No wonder it took four years.
